Here perhaps {{ls}}ome man may a{{ls}}ke, vvhether heretikes al{{ls}}o v{{ls}}e not the te{{ls}}timonies of diuine Scripture. Yes in deede do they, and that vehemently. For thou {{ls}}halt {{ls}}ee them flie through euery one of the {{ls}}acred bookes of the Lavv, through Moy{{ls}}es, the bookes of the kings, the P{{ls}}almes, the Apo{{ls}}tles, the Go{{ls}}pels,the Prophets. For, vvhether among their ovvne fellowes, or {{ls}}trangers: vvhether priuatly, or publikely: vvhether in talke, or in their bookes: vvhether in bankets, or in the {{ls}}treates: they ''I {{ls}}ay)alleage nothing of their ovvne, which they endeuour not to {{ls}}hadow vvith the wordes of Scripture al{{ls}}o. Read the vvorkes of Paulus Samo{{ls}}atenus, of Pri{{ls}}cillian, of Eunomian, of Iouinian, * of'' {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=* Of Caluin, of Iuel, of the re{{ls}}t.}} ''the other plagues & pe{{ls}}tilences: thou {{ls}}halt finde an infinite heape of examples,no page in a manner omitted or voide, vvhich is not painted and coloured with the {{ls}}entences of the new or old te{{ls}}tament. But they are {{ls}}o much the more to be taken heede of,& to be'' feared, the ''more {{ls}}ecretly they lurke vnder the {{ls}}hadovves of Gods diuine law. For they knovv their {{ls}}tinkes vvould not ea{{ls}}ily plea{{ls}}e any man'' almo{{ls}}t, if ''they were breathed out nakedly & {{ls}}imply them {{ls}}elues alone, & therfore they {{ls}}prinkle them as it vvere vvith certaine pretious {{ls}}pices of the heauenly vvord: to the end that he vvhich would ea{{ls}}ely de{{ls}}pi{{ls}}e the errour of'' man, may ''not ea{{ls}}ely contemne the oracles of'' God. So ''that they doe like vnto them, vvhich vvhen they vvil prepare certaine bitter potions for'' children, do ''fir{{ls}}t anoint the brimmes of the cup vvith honie, that the vnvvarie'' age, vvhen ''it {{ls}}hal fir{{ls}}t feele the'' {{ls}}vvetnes, may ''not feare the bitternes.''

5 The cau{{ls}}e vvhy, the Scriptures being perfit, yet vve v{{ls}}e other Eccle{{ls}}ia{{ls}}tical vvritings and tradition.

''Vincentius Lirinen{{ls}}is in his golden booke before cited, aduer{{ls}}us prophanas hære{{ls}}um Nouationes.''

Here {{ls}}ome man perhaps may a{{ls}}ke, for a{{ls}}much as the Canon of the Scriptures is perfit,and in all pointes very {{ls}}ufficient in it {{ls}}elf, vvhat neede is there, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=* So he calleth the Churches {{ls}}en{{ls}}e, and the fathers interpretations of Scriptures.}}to ioyne therevnto the authoritie of the* Eccle{{ls}}ia{{ls}}tical vnder{{ls}}tanding? for this cau{{ls}}e {{ls}}urely,for that all take not the holy Scripture in one and the {{ls}}ame {{ls}}en{{ls}}e, becau{{ls}}e of the deepenes thereof. but the {{ls}}peaches thereof, {{ls}}ome interpret one vvay, & {{ls}}ome an other vvay, {{ls}}o that there may almo{{ls}}t as many {{ls}}en{{ls}}es be picked out of it, as there be men. for, ''Nouatian'' doth expound it one vvay, and ''Sabellius, an other vvay, othervvi{{ls}}e Donatus,'' othervvife Arius, ''Eunomius, Macedonius, othervvi{{ls}}e Photinus, Apollinaris, Pri{{ls}}cillianus, othervvi{{ls}}e Iouinian,'' {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=* Othervvi{{ls}}e vvicleffe, Luther, Caluin, Puritanes.}} ''Pelagius, Cele{{ls}}tius, la{{ls}}tly othervvi{{ls}}e Ne{{ls}}torius.* And therfore very nece{{ls}}{{ls}}arie it is, becau{{ls}}e of {{ls}}o great vvindinges and turninges of diuers errours, that the line of'' Prophetical ''and Apo{{ls}}tolical interpretation, be directed according to the rule of the Eccle{{ls}}ia{{ls}}tical and Catholike {{ls}}en{{ls}}e or vnder{{ls}}tanding.''

''S. Ba{{ls}}il li. de Spiritu {{ls}}ancto cap. 27.''

Of {{ls}}uch articles of religion as are kept and preached in the Churche, {{ls}}ome vvere taught by the vvritten vvord, other {{ls}}ome vve haue receiued by the tradition of the Apo{{ls}}tles, deliuered vnto vs as it vvere from hand to hand in my{{ls}}terie {{ls}}ecretly: both vvhich be of one force to Chri{{ls}}tian religion: and this no man vvil deny that hath any litle {{ls}}kill of the Eccle{{ls}}ia{{ls}}tical rites or cu{{ls}}tomes. for if vve goe about to reiect the cu{{ls}}tomes not conteined in Scripture, as being of {{ls}}mal force, vve {{ls}}hal vnvvittingly and vnavvares mangle the GOSPEL it {{ls}}elf in the principal partes thereof, yea rather,vve {{ls}}hal abridge the very preaching of the Go{{ls}}pel,and bring it to a bare name.<noinclude>{{continues|THE}}</noinclude>
